intro.h2: Remodels finished on schedule, down to the last tile
paragraphs: Complete Home Remodeling Services, llc. handles kitchen and bath remodeling in Stevensville, MD, led by owner Gabriel Galeano. Bathrooms are the job reviewers bring up most, in 11 of 31 Google reviews, and the photos show why: tiled walk-in showers, tub surrounds and recessed niches lined with hexagon mosaic.

Kitchens get the same care. One family hired the crew for a kitchen remodel and added new rear sliding doors, siding on the back of the house, new hose bibs and drywall patches where ductwork moved. They say the work was completed within the timeframe provided and any issues were addressed immediately.

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: Shaker cabinets, a peninsula with seating, new counters and a tile backsplash can turn a dated kitchen into the room everyone gathers in. One client says the work speaks for itself and the outcome is beautiful, and another plans to call Gabriel when she is ready for her kitchen.

image.alt: Kitchen peninsula with white counters, rush-seat stools, a glass pendant light and white shaker cabinets

items.name: Full bathroom remodels
items.blurb: From the tub surround to the vanity, Gabriel's crew rebuilds whole bathrooms. One homeowner had both of her bathrooms remodeled and says they turned out beautifully. Another says Gabriel did a complete bathroom remodel at a great price and came back right away when an issue came up later.

image.alt: Bathroom with a white tub, large gray tile surround and a blue and white hexagon mosaic niche

items.name: Tile showers and niches
items.blurb: Walk-in showers here get large-format wall tile, a mosaic floor, a recessed niche and often a sliding glass door. One client says the niche is her favorite part of her new shower. Gabriel lays out options for tile and layout rather than one fixed plan.

image.alt: Walk-in shower with a sliding glass door, gray tile walls and a hexagon mosaic floor and niche

items.name: Doors, siding and drywall repairs
items.blurb: Remodels often uncover other work. Alongside one kitchen remodel, the crew replaced rear sliding doors, re-sided the back of the house, changed hose bibs and patched drywall where ductwork had moved. Another family had cracked ceilings in other rooms patched while their bathrooms were done.

about.h2: About Gabriel Galeano and his crew
about.text: Complete Home Remodeling Services, llc. is owned by Gabriel Galeano, who signs his replies to Google reviews himself and prints his Maryland Home Improvement Commission number, MHIC #160195, on his business card. The company is based at 219 Ackerman Rd in Stevensville. Gabriel writes the proposals and lays out options, and his crew does the building, from shower tile to siding. Clients call them hardworking, patient and kind, and one review describes the team as true craftsmen. Bathroom remodels are the work they are asked about most.

items.name: Corey M.
items.text: Gabriel and his team were awesome. They are hardworking, patient and kind. We hired Complete Home Remodeling Services for a kitchen remodel last summer. On top of remodeling the kitchen we changed out rear sliding doors, resided the rear of the home, changed out our hose bibs and had multiple areas of drywall patched where we had ductwork moved. The work was completed within the timeframe provided and any issues that arose were addressed immediately. The work speaks for itself and the outcome is beautiful. Would definitely recommend!

items.name: Elizabeth W.
items.text: Gabriel and the men who work for him are polite, kind, clean and professional, I couldn't recommend them more. Gabriel did a complete bathroom remodel for me at a great price. I had an issue a few months after and Gabriel took care of it immediately. He went above and beyond to make sure I was happy. I can not recommend them enough and will have them back to do my kitchen when I'm ready.

items.name: Jaclyn H.
items.text: Our experience with Complete Home Remodeling Services has been excellent! We had both our bathrooms remodeled and they turned out beautifully. Gabriel is very detailed with his proposals and we appreciate his transparency and flexibility with providing us options. His team did amazing work and were very kind/respectful while in our home. They even help do some patch work on our cracked ceilings in other rooms. The photos highlight the showers as I love how they turned out, the niche is my favorite. I would recommend Gabriel and his team over and over again. Plus I now have someone I am highly confident in to call for future projects!

service_area.h2: Kitchen and bath remodeling in Stevensville, MD, from Ackerman Rd
service_area.text: Complete Home Remodeling Services, llc. is based at 219 Ackerman Rd, Stevensville, MD 21666. Google does not list a wider service area, so if your home is outside Stevensville, call (240) 398-0471 with your town and a short description of the kitchen, bathroom or repair you have in mind, and ask whether it is within reach. Hours are Monday to Friday 8 AM to 6 PM and Saturday 8 AM to 3 PM.

items.a: Yes. Gabriel's business card lists MHIC #160195, the Maryland Home Improvement Commission number for Complete Home Remodeling Services, llc. You can check the number with the Maryland Home Improvement Commission before you sign, and it is a good habit with any contractor you hire.

items.q: Do you remodel both kitchens and bathrooms?
items.a: Yes. Bathroom remodels come up in 11 Google reviews, including one family who had both bathrooms redone. Kitchens are covered too: one client hired the crew for a full kitchen remodel last summer, and another plans to bring them back for her kitchen.

items.q: Can you handle other repairs during a remodel?
items.a: Yes. Along with one kitchen remodel, the crew replaced rear sliding doors, re-sided the back of the house, swapped hose bibs and patched drywall. Another family had cracked ceilings patched in other rooms while their bathrooms were remodeled. Mention any extra items when you ask for a proposal.

items.q: What happens if something needs fixing after the job?
items.a: One client had an issue a few months after her bathroom remodel and says Gabriel took care of it immediately and went above and beyond to make sure she was happy. Call (240) 398-0471 if you notice anything after your project is finished.

Complete Home Remodeling Services, llc. is open Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 6 PM and Saturday from 8 AM to 3 PM, and closed on Sunday. Call (240) 398-0471 or email chrservices2023@gmail.com to request a proposal for your project.
